corpus_stability.reason: The Oklahoma Driver Manual is a periodically revised official edition, so Section Six lane and maneuver rules change at most with new editions.

market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E

sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Lane Usage and Maneuvers

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A01
Yellow divides opposing flows while white divides same-direction flows, and solid yellow bars passing where dashes permit it [A01].
Why it matters: group line-colors; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A01
Two-lane centers invite safe passes, three-lane centers serve left turns only, and four-lane centers seal on double solid [A01].
Why it matters: group centers; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F01; confusables sec06-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A02
Safe changes chain clearance, mirrors, signal, shoulder, recheck, and blind-spot clearance, and leaders earning the same courtesy slow down [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-change; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A02
Expressways bind speed between a forty minimum and a fifty-five-to-seventy-five maximum, and crawling below minimum is itself illegal [A02].
Why it matters: group express-speed; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A02
Slower drivers keep right while faster drivers take middle or left, and packs, abreast cruising, and weaving all break the rule [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-choice; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A03
Trail three seconds or four in weather, scan fifteen to twenty ahead, and reach missed exits by re-entering rather than crossing medians [A03].
Why it matters: group gaps-and-scan; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F06 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A03
Entries yield then accelerate rightward and merge left-signaled, while exits stage early, hold flow speed, signal right one hundred feet out, and slow inside the ramp [A03].
Why it matters: group enter-vs-leave; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A03
Forced stops pull fully onto the extreme right shoulder with flashers lit, and feet stay off the roadway edges [A03].
Why it matters: group breakdown; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A04
Left-lane loafing that impedes flow breaks the rule on wide roads, and no pass ever excuses speeding [A04].
Why it matters: group left-lane; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F10 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A04
Left passes demand two hundred clear feet, mirror and shoulder clearance, and mirror-visible returns before pulling back [A04].
Why it matters: group pass-left; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A04
Right passes fit wide clear multi-lane roads, one-way roads, and left-turning leaders only, and pavement departures never qualify [A04].
Why it matters: group pass-right; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F11; confusables sec06-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R12 | anchor: A04
Solid-yellow-in-lane, hills, curves, and hundred-foot blind approaches ban passing, while passed drivers hold lane, edge right, freeze speed, and slow for closers [A04].
Why it matters: group no-pass-and-passed; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R13 | anchor: A05
Signals must start one hundred feet or a third of a block early, arms extend straight for left, rise for right, and drop palm-back for slow or stop [A05].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F14 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec06-R14 | anchor: A05
Six-step turns brake before the line, accelerate gently through, and hold wheels straight while awaiting gaps [A05].
Why it matters: group turn-steps; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F14; confusables sec06-F15 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec06-R15 | anchor: A06
Lefts run five steps hugging center while rights run four hugging curb, and every turn holds ten or less [A06].
Why it matters: group left-vs-right; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F15; confusables sec06-F16 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-R16 | anchor: A07
One-way turns leave from curb-nearest lanes, and the crossing diagram turns westbound left-laners left and southbound right-laners right [A07].
Why it matters: group one-way-turns; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F18 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R17 | anchor: A08
Backing stares through rear glass with twelve o'clock grip and seatback arm, creeps tail-first, and scouts behind before boarding [A08].
Why it matters: group backing; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F19 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0039]
